newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares unnerved by U.S. inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares unnerved by U.S. inflation data.

text.p: Austrian shares ended the week 1.09 percent lower in response to stronger-than-expected U.S. March inflation data and traders predicted further declines next week.
The market had been soft overall before the figures, traders said. "The producer prices were the final blow," said one trader.
Dealers were sceptical about the chance of a pick-up next week.
"I see the market declining further at the beginning, with a recovery in the course of the week," said one.
"It could still go as low as 1,140," said another.
Traders said a raft of Austrian company results due next week and Wall Street's moves would be the key driving factors.
"Good results could stabilise the market. Ultimately though it will depend how Wall Street reacts to the producer prices," said one trader.
Regional electricity company EVN, engineering group VA Tech and Vienna airport operator Flughafen Wien will post 1996 results next week.
The blue chip ATX index slipped 12.84 points, or 1.09 percent, to 1,163.95 points. Among its constituents 14 shares fell, four rose and three were unchanged.
The session's biggest gainer was textile maker Lenzing, adding 2.73 percent to 678 schillings.
The leading decliner was VA Tech, shedding 2.84 percent to 1,662 schillings.
The April ATX future lost 19.2 points to end at 1,155.
